hlg_prime: Ensure applicant compliance and data accuracy before submission
hlg_original: Enable applicants to submit complete, valid, and legally compliant AUU applications by providing guided data entry, real-time fiscal code validation, and mandatory acceptance of declarations and privacy notices.

hlg_prime: Support applicants in managing and resuming multi-participant application drafts with persistent state and collaborative payment adjustments.
hlg_original: Allow applicants to save drafts, resume, or modify applications, and enable the second parent to complete or adjust allowance distribution and payment details for joint applications.

hlg_prime: Validate fiscal codes for children against national databases to ensure uniqueness and avoid conflicts.
hlg_original: Prevent duplicate or conflicting applications by validating child fiscal codes in real time and blocking submissions when a child is already associated with another active application.

hlg_prime: Automatically adjust the allowance amount based on ISEE data to ensure regulatory compliance and reduce manual intervention.
hlg_original: Ensure accurate allowance amounts by using the minimum regulated amount if no valid ISEE is available, and automatically recalculating when valid ISEE data becomes available without requiring applicant intervention.

hlg_prime: Configure and validate payment methods and distribution for allowance disbursement
hlg_original: Allow applicants to select from multiple secure payment methods including SEPA IBAN, post office domiciliation, and eligible prepaid cards, with support for joint payment between parents.

hlg_prime: Resolve a suspended application by uploading required documents, reconfirming data, and reaccepting legal declarations.
hlg_original: Inform applicants of application outcomes (accepted, rejected, suspended) and allow them to upload required documents, reconfirm data, and reaccept declarations when an application is suspended.

hlg_prime: Automatically manage the lifecycle of accepted applications by triggering monthly payments and extending validity for 12 months upon successful payment or approval.
hlg_original: Ensure accepted applications remain valid for 12 months and trigger automatic monthly payments without requiring further action from the applicant.

hlg_prime: Validate fiscal codes and recalculate allowances when a new child is added to an application.
hlg_original: Allow applicants to add new children to existing applications, validate fiscal codes, and modify payment or declaration data without restarting the application.

hlg_prime: Support applicant self-service for application history, informational resources, and allowance simulation.
hlg_original: Enable applicants to consult past applications, access general AUU information, and simulate expected monthly allowance amounts to support informed decision-making.

hlg_prime: Securely manage and audit personal and financial data in compliance with GDPR
hlg_original: Maintain data privacy and compliance with GDPR by requiring explicit acceptance of privacy notices and securely managing personal and financial data throughout the application lifecycle.

hlg_prime: Allow users to input, compute, and view the result of arithmetic expressions via a virtual keypad interface.
hlg_original: Provide users with a reliable and intuitive interface to perform fundamental calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

hlg_prime: Provide customers with transparent product information including origin, quality certifications, and availability status.
hlg_original: Enable customers to make informed purchasing decisions by providing detailed information about product origin, quality, and availability.

hlg_prime: Manage customer order lifecycle including submission, updates, and prioritization based on fair-play score for limited products.
hlg_original: Support the weekly purchasing cycle by enabling customers to place orders, manage modifications, and prioritize based on fair-play scores during limited availability.

hlg_prime: Enable customers to securely pay for products using their virtual wallet with real-time balance monitoring and funding options.
hlg_original: Allow customers to pay for orders using a personal virtual wallet, with flexible recharge options and clear notifications for insufficient balances.

hlg_prime: Manage customer pickup scheduling and enforcement of time-bound order fulfillment.
hlg_original: Ensure customers can schedule and complete product pickups with reminders and forfeiture mechanisms to maintain system reliability.

hlg_prime: Maintain accurate and up-to-date product availability records for farmers
hlg_original: Allow farmers to submit product availability estimates and enable the system to manage allocation based on real-time availability and customer priority.

hlg_prime: Compensate the customer for delivery delays by notifying them and crediting their wallet.
hlg_original: Notify customers of delivery delays and automatically credit back payments with bonuses when goods are not delivered by the deadline.

hlg_prime: Manage and fulfill customer orders end-to-end by tracking status, assigning logistics, confirming payment, and updating customer records.
hlg_original: Enable store employees to manage orders, process payments, schedule pickups, and handle delivery confirmations with automated reminders and status updates.

hlg_prime: Maintain customer fair-play scores by updating them based on employee observations of reliability and rule adherence.
hlg_original: Track and reward customer reliability through a fair-play score system to ensure equitable allocation during product shortages.

hlg_prime: Notify customers of changes to their order status or wallet balance due to system actions or staff interventions.
hlg_original: Provide mechanisms for customers to receive notifications, modify orders, and be informed of system actions such as cancellations or bonuses.

hlg_prime: Manage event planning and financial oversight from setup to execution
hlg_original: Enable event organizers to efficiently plan, coordinate, and manage all aspects of an event, including guest invitations, service bookings, and budget tracking.

hlg_prime: Manage service provider operations including listing services, handling bookings, and processing payments.
hlg_original: Allow service providers to showcase their services, receive appointment requests, and manage payments in a transparent and efficient manner.

hlg_prime: Support invited guests in engaging with event content and activities via their invitation code.
hlg_original: Enable invited guests to access event details, contribute to event content, and participate in event-related activities through personalized access.

hlg_prime: Support user tracking and analysis of workout activities over time
hlg_original: Provide a comprehensive platform for users to log, visualize, and interpret their workout data to understand performance trends.

hlg_prime: Support user-defined fitness goals with milestone tracking and real-time feedback
hlg_original: Allow users to define measurable fitness objectives and provide tools to monitor progress toward those goals.

hlg_prime: Adapt workout plans based on user fitness data and feedback
hlg_original: Use user data to generate customized, adaptive workout plans that evolve with user progress and preferences.

hlg_prime: Adapt workout plans progressively based on user achievement milestones
hlg_original: Offer onboarding content, step-by-step workout routines, and milestone-based progression to help new users build confidence and consistency.

hlg_prime: Secure and audit user data access by encrypting data, enforcing role-based access, and logging access activities for review.
hlg_original: Maintain secure storage and controlled access to user data while ensuring the app’s reliability and performance.

hlg_prime: Manage and deploy fitness content and system configurations globally
hlg_original: Allow administrators to modify workout libraries, adjust settings, and deploy new features or content updates.

hlg_prime: Admin manages user data lifecycle through aggregation, export, and import for operational oversight and system setup.
hlg_original: Enable administrators to monitor usage patterns, manage user accounts, and generate insights for improving the app’s offerings.

hlg_prime: Annotate and prioritize genetic variants with functional, disease, and population context for informed interpretation
hlg_original: Support researchers in understanding the biological and functional implications of genetic variants by providing comprehensive annotation and prediction tools, including mapping to reference assemblies and conversion of DNA changes to protein-level changes.

hlg_prime: Support clinical decision-making by enabling accurate, standardized interpretation and exchange of variant data
hlg_original: Enable clinicians to diagnose and treat patients by providing clinically relevant variant annotations, disease associations, functional impact predictions, and integration with public databases and clinical knowledge.

hlg_prime: Maintain accurate hospital operational data including facility details and real-time bed availability.
hlg_original: Provide a unified platform to manage hospitals, patients, beds, products, and blood-bank resources across multiple facilities.

hlg_prime: Optimize hospital resource allocation and operational efficiency through staff and bed assignment and performance reporting.
hlg_original: Enable hospital managers to efficiently allocate beds, staff, and supplies to improve operational performance.

hlg_prime: The Patient schedules a care service appointment by searching for nearby hospitals and selecting available providers.
hlg_original: Allow patients to search for nearby hospitals and schedule care services based on availability and proximity.

hlg_prime: Manage patient medical records and appointment workflows throughout the care continuum.
hlg_original: Enable healthcare staff to register patients, consult medical histories, manage appointments, check-ins, and treatment notes seamlessly.

hlg_prime: Manage medical inventory by monitoring stock levels and processing supply requests.
hlg_original: Allow authorized staff to manage product inventory, request fulfillment, and blood sample tracking to ensure supply chain integrity.

hlg_prime: Onboard suppliers by collecting their identity and product details for account creation and administrative review.
hlg_original: Enable suppliers to register and submit detailed product proposals that can be reviewed and managed by administrators to streamline the product introduction process.

hlg_prime: Manage proposal approval and revision workflow
hlg_original: Allow administrators to evaluate, approve, reject, or request revisions on supplier proposals with automated reminders and time-bound workflows to ensure timely decisions.

hlg_prime: Receive and log incoming products into inventory with assigned storage and availability status.
hlg_original: Enable store staff to inspect delivered products, confirm receipt, assign locations, and update availability to maintain accurate inventory and operational efficiency.

hlg_prime: Ensure optimal response time by verifying route compliance with standard protocols.
hlg_original: Minimize response time to ensure every emergency call is reached within 11 minutes.

hlg_prime: Log and validate ambulance dispatch details for resource tracking
hlg_original: Record precise departure and destination information to support efficient resource allocation.

hlg_prime: Assign the most suitable ambulance to an incident based on real-time location and availability.
hlg_original: Assign the most suitable available ambulance to each call within the maximum time limit.

hlg_prime: Assign emergency incidents accurately based on confirmed location and urgency.
hlg_original: Ensure emergency callers provide sufficient location and urgency details to enable effective dispatch.

hlg_prime: Facilitate collaborative sprint planning by enabling transparent, anonymous estimation and collective agreement on goals and user stories.
hlg_original: Ensure that all team members can collaboratively estimate and agree on sprint goals without bias or dominance from any single individual.

hlg_prime: Manage and visualize sprint workload and user story priorities to optimize team capacity and planning efficiency.
hlg_original: Support the Product Owner in ensuring that the team collectively understands and commits to the sprint goals and their relative effort.

hlg_prime: Support real-time task estimation alignment and transparency across development team members
hlg_original: Allow Development Team Members to actively participate in estimating work and building shared understanding of task complexity.

hlg_prime: Provide users with location-based access to recycling centers and their detailed information.
hlg_original: Provide a seamless search experience for users to find recycling centers based on their location, supporting environmental responsibility and convenience.

hlg_prime: Provide users with current and upcoming operational hours for facilities.
hlg_original: Ensure users can access up-to-date operational hours and contact details to plan visits effectively and reduce unnecessary trips.

hlg_prime: Support user navigation to recycling facilities with timely event notifications and interactive mapping.
hlg_original: Deliver timely notifications about recycling events and provide interactive maps to enhance user participation and awareness.

hlg_prime: Maintain accurate facility operational status for administrative and user reference.
hlg_original: Allow administrators to manage and verify facility information to maintain data integrity and support community recycling initiatives.

hlg_prime: Manage user feedback by categorizing and routing for resolution
hlg_original: Provide administrators with tools to collect, categorize, and respond to user feedback to improve service quality and user satisfaction.

hlg_prime: Facility representative reports issues or requests updates to administrators.
hlg_original: Establish a secure and streamlined channel for facility representatives to report issues, request updates, or collaborate with admins to enhance recycling operations.

hlg_prime: Securely manage user data access and integrity through authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging.
hlg_original: Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive user data and administrative communications, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.

hlg_prime: Citizen reports incidents with details and tracks their status.
hlg_original: Allow citizens to report urban issues and track the status of their reports to foster transparency and civic engagement.

hlg_prime: Manage report status transitions through approval or rejection by organization office staff.
hlg_original: Provide a structured workflow for reports to move through approval, assignment, and resolution stages with clear state transitions and accountability.
Enable seamless coordination between technical offices and external maintenance personnel to resolve urban issues efficiently.

hlg_prime: External Maintenance Personnel manages assigned reports by viewing their status and updating details securely.
hlg_original: Allow external maintenance companies to access and update reports assigned to them, with secure communication channels for internal coordination.

hlg_prime: Notify citizen of report status updates via email and in-app notification
hlg_original: Ensure citizens receive timely updates on report status and communication via platform notifications and emails to build trust in public administration.

hlg_prime: Provide public access to aggregated statistics on report trends and categories.
hlg_original: Allow non-registered users to view public statistics on report trends and categories to promote awareness and data-driven urban planning.

hlg_prime: Manage urban reporting and external access configuration
hlg_original: Provide municipal administrators with private access to detailed statistics and system configuration tools to manage external company access and optimize resource allocation.
